hook: Your drive here goes 9 km under a Himalayan pass.
title: The World's Longest High-Altitude Tunnel
description:
The Atal Tunnel in Himachal Pradesh runs about 9 km beneath the Rohtang Pass. It is the longest highway tunnel in the world above 10,000 feet. It keeps this Himalayan road open when snow blocks the pass.

#Shorts #Geography #India
